+package com.oracle.test.integration.keypair;
+
+import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
+import java.security.SecureRandom;
+import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;
+
+public class FixedSizeRand extends SecureRandom {
+
+    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
+    ByteBuffer buf;
+
+    FixedSizeRand(int size) {
+        byte[] fixedRand = new byte[size];
+        ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextBytes(fixedRand);
+        buf = ByteBuffer.wrap(fixedRand);
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public void nextBytes(byte[] bytes) {
+        // Rewind when fully drained to allow for reuse.
+        if (buf.remaining() == 0) {
+            buf.rewind();
+        }
+        buf.get(bytes);
+    }
+}

+package com.oracle.jipher.internal.key;
+
+import java.util.Optional;
+
+import org.junit.Test;
+
+import com.oracle.jipher.internal.key.JceMlKey.Algorithm;
+
+import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
+
+
+public class JceMlKeyTest {
+
+    @Test
+    public void testFind() {
+        Optional<Algorithm> mlDsa = JceMlKey.find("ML-DSA");
+        assertTrue(mlDsa.isEmpty());
+        Optional<Algorithm> mlKem = JceMlKey.find("ML-KEM");
+        assertTrue(mlKem.isEmpty());
+    }
+
+    @Test (expected = IllegalArgumentException.class)
+    public void testGetStrAlgIdMlDsa() {
+        JceMlKey.getStrAlgId("ML-DSA");
+    }
+
+    @Test (expected = IllegalArgumentException.class)
+    public void testGetStrAlgIdMlKem() {
+        JceMlKey.getStrAlgId("ML-KEM");
+    }
+}

+def namedGroups = ['SecP256r1']
+
+if (TEST_PQC_GROUPS) {
+    namedGroups += [
+            'X25519MLKEM768',
+            'SecP256r1MLKEM768',
+            'SecP384r1MLKEM1024'
+    ]
+}
+
+namedGroups.each { namedGroup ->
+    tlsProvConfigs.each { config ->
+        def configName = config[0]
+        def clientCfg = config[1]
+        def serverCfg = config[2]
+        tasks.register("jsseTest_(${configName})_${namedGroup}", Test) {
+            description = "Run JSSE test for provider cfg ${configName} with named group ${namedGroup}"
+            group = 'deploy-test'
+            testClassesDirs = sourceSets.systemTest.output
+            classpath = sourceSets.systemTest.runtimeClasspath
+
+            // From JDK 9 onward internal JDK APIs are no longer accessible by default
+            jvmArgs += '--add-exports=java.base/sun.security.internal.spec=com.oracle.jipher'
+            jvmArgs += '--add-exports=java.base/sun.security.util=com.oracle.jipher'
+            // Suppress restricted method warnings related to accessing methods considered to be unsafe
+            // See https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/25/core/restricted-methods.html
+            jvmArgs += '--enable-native-access=com.oracle.jipher'
+
+            forkEvery = 1
+
+            systemProperty 'java.security.properties', "$projectDir/config/java.security/${clientCfg}.java.security"
+            systemProperty 'security.config.client', clientCfg
+            systemProperty 'security.config.server', serverCfg
+
+            systemProperty 'jdk.tls.namedGroups', namedGroup
+
+            include 'com/oracle/systest/tls/**'
+
+            finalizedBy 'testReport'
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+tasks.register('jsseTest_namedGroups') {
+    description = 'Run JSSE tests for all TLS provider and library configurations and namedGroups'
+    group = 'deploy-test'
+    namedGroups.each { namedGroup ->
+        tlsProvConfigs.each { prov_cfg ->
+            dependsOn "jsseTest_(${prov_cfg[0]})_${namedGroup}"
+        }
+    }
+}
